result.instructions: Tools for Gift Up!, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many gift cards did we sell this month and for how much?"; "Show the latest gift card orders, newest first."; "Which gift cards still have a balance left?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Gift Up! data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run giftup_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run giftup_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run giftup_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. giftup_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: giftup_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: The Gift Up account this API key belongs to: id, name, currency, whether onboarding is complete and whether the checkout is live. GET /company.

tools.name: giftup_list_gift_cards
tools.title: List gift cards
tools.description: List gift cards with balance, status flags (canBeRedeemed, hasExpired, notYetValid, isVoided), title, recipient, expiry and the order they came from. Codes are MASKED (at least 6 characters stay hidden); to see one card in full (code and ledger) use giftup_get_gift_card with its code. Filter by state, creation/update time, order, SKU, recipient/purchaser email or payment transaction id. GET /gift-cards.

status.description: Only gift cards in this state.

created_on_or_after.description: Only gift cards created on or after this time (UTC).

updated_on_or_after.description: Only gift cards updated on or after this time (UTC).

order_id.description: Only gift cards of this order id.

sku.description: Only gift cards with this private SKU.

recipient_email.description: Only gift cards sent to this recipient email address.

purchaser_email.description: Only gift cards bought by this purchaser email address.

payment_transaction_id.description: Only gift cards whose payment-provider transaction id matches.

offset.description: Results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

test_mode.description: Read the account's test data instead of live data (sends x-giftup-testmode: true). Default false.

tools.name: giftup_get_gift_card
tools.title: Get gift card
tools.description: One gift card by its code: balance (remainingValue / remainingUnits), status flags, expiry, recipient, order, fulfilment and the full ledger of events (created, redeemed, topped up, voided). Returns the code in full because you asked for this card by code; do not repeat it elsewhere. Read-only: it never redeems or changes the card. GET /gift-cards/{code}.

test_mode.description: Read the account's test data instead of live data (sends x-giftup-testmode: true). Default false.

tools.name: giftup_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders (the purchases that created gift cards), newest first: order number, purchaser, revenue, tip, fees, discount, applied promotions, source, notes, metadata and payment provider. Filter by creation time, purchaser email or source. GET /orders.

created_on_or_after.description: Only orders created on or after this time (UTC).

purchaser_email.description: Only orders by this purchaser email address.

offset.description: Results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

test_mode.description: Read the account's test data instead of live data (sends x-giftup-testmode: true). Default false.

tools.name: giftup_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by id: totals, purchaser, promotions, custom fields, sales taxes, notes, metadata and payment provider. GET /orders/{id}.

order_id.description: The order id (a GUID, from giftup_list_orders).

test_mode.description: Read the account's test data instead of live data (sends x-giftup-testmode: true). Default false.

tools.name: giftup_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: List the gift card products on sale (items): name, price, value, price type, availability window, group, stock level, per-order limit, SKU and terms. Pre-generated codes are reduced to a count and masked tails. Optionally only one group. GET /items.

group_id.description: Only items in this item group id.

test_mode.description: Read the account's test data instead of live data (sends x-giftup-testmode: true). Default false.

tools.name: giftup_get_item
tools.title: Get item
tools.description: One item (gift card product) by id. Pre-generated codes are reduced to a count and masked tails. GET /items/{id}.

item_id.description: The item id (a GUID, from giftup_list_items).

test_mode.description: Read the account's test data instead of live data (sends x-giftup-testmode: true). Default false.

tools.name: giftup_list_item_groups
tools.title: List item groups
tools.description: List item groups (the sections that organize items in the checkout): id, name, description, sort order, auto-expand. GET /groups.

test_mode.description: Read the account's test data instead of live data (sends x-giftup-testmode: true). Default false.

tools.name: giftup_get_item_group
tools.title: Get item group
tools.description: One item group by id. GET /groups/{id}.

group_id.description: The item group id (a GUID, from giftup_list_item_groups).

test_mode.description: Read the account's test data instead of live data (sends x-giftup-testmode: true). Default false.

tools.name: giftup_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the locations (stores) of the account; their ids filter and label report transactions. GET /locations.

test_mode.description: Read the account's test data instead of live data (sends x-giftup-testmode: true). Default false.

tools.name: giftup_list_promotions
tools.title: List promotions
tools.description: List promotions (checkout discounts and bonus credit): name, published/stopped dates, benefits (percentage and fixed discounts, extra credit), usage counts and revenue, limitations and triggers (items, groups, spend and quantity thresholds, promo code). Read-only. GET /promotions.

test_mode.description: Read the account's test data instead of live data (sends x-giftup-testmode: true). Default false.

tools.name: giftup_list_transactions
tools.title: List report transactions
tools.description: The immutable financial transaction log: OrderPlaced (income, fees, tip), GiftCardCreated, CreditAdded, Redeemed, Expired, Unexpired, Voided, Reactivated, with who, where, reason, Gift Up fee and the value change. Gift card codes are MASKED (at least 6 characters stay hidden). Filter by time range, event type, user email, location id or one gift card code. GET /reports/transactions.

event_occurred_on_or_after.description: Only events on or after this time (UTC).

event_occurred_on_or_before.description: Only events on or before this time (UTC).

users.description: Only events generated by these user email addresses.

locations.description: Only events at these location ids (see giftup_list_locations).

code.description: Only events of the gift card with this code.

offset.description: Results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

test_mode.description: Read the account's test data instead of live data (sends x-giftup-testmode: true). Default false.

tools.name: giftup_get_transaction
tools.title: Get report transaction
tools.description: One report transaction by id. The gift card code inside is MASKED (at least 6 characters stay hidden). GET /reports/transactions/{id}.

transaction_id.description: The transaction id (a GUID, from giftup_list_transactions).

test_mode.description: Read the account's test data instead of live data (sends x-giftup-testmode: true). Default false.
